entries.title: Jeremiah 45:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: I find no rest - Upon Baruch's reading the prophecies both he and Jeremiah were advised to hide themselves. This probably disturbed Baruch, and made him lament his condition.

entries.title: Jeremiah 45:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Seek them not - Dost thou expect what none is like to meet with who feareth God? Upon all flesh - I am bringing calamities upon the whole nation.
